question: Should `/workspace` become a supported alias inside runtime Docker and Podman containers, or remain reserved for sandbox-container workspaces?
rationale: Current main and the latest release consistently distinguish these paths, while the requested alias offers real ergonomics; selecting the permanent public filesystem convention requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Support the alias consistently
options.body: Expose `/workspace` across Docker and Podman runtime containers while retaining the canonical workspace path and adding permission, mount, and smoke coverage.

options.title: Keep sandbox-only semantics
options.body: Retain the current runtime path and revise agent templates or documentation so `/workspace` is not implied outside sandbox containers.

recommendation.title: Support the alias consistently
recommendation.body: Expose `/workspace` across Docker and Podman runtime containers while retaining the canonical workspace path and adding permission, mount, and smoke coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history and the prior maintainer-side review connect this person to both the container and sandbox path-contract surfaces.
